entities.name: Shattered Isles
entities.description: An archipelago of broken basalt spires that are remnants of Argoth, part of the Terisian Isles of Dominaria.

entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: Land destroyed when Urza activated the Golgothian Sylex.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Activated the Golgothian Sylex at the end of the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: Artifact whose explosion broke the land beneath Argoth.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: War ending with the activation of the Sylex.

entities.name: Flooding of Terisiare
entities.description: Event in which the Shattered Sea formed as Fyndhorn and Kelsinko sank.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: Formed a team of mages that failed to hold back the waters.

entities.name: Fyndhorn
entities.description: Forest the elves migrated to, later sunk.

entities.name: Kelsinko
entities.description: Land that sank during the Flooding.

entities.name: Shattered Sea
entities.description: Sea that formed around the islands.

events.summary: Urza activates the Golgothian Sylex, destroying Argoth.
events.quote: Urza activated the Golgothian Sylex , causing a massive explosion that broke the land beneath it.

events.summary: Jaya Ballard's team of mages fails to keep the waters at bay in the Flooding of Terisiare.
events.quote: Jaya Ballard formed a team of mages to attempt to keep the waters at bay, but failed.

relations.note: Destroyed it with the Golgothian Sylex
relations.quote: Argoth was utterly destroyed, and most life near it perished.
